parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use trig formula and obtain an equation in $\sin\theta$ and $\cos\theta$, e.g. $\sin\theta\cos30^\circ-\cos\theta\sin30^\circ+\cos\theta=2\sin\theta$. Condone sign error in expansion and/or omission of “$+\cos\theta$”. [M1*]
Obtain an equation in $\tan\theta$, e.g. $\tan\theta=\dfrac{1-\sin30^\circ}{2-\cos30^\circ}$. Can be implied by correct answer following correct expansion; otherwise working is needed. [M1(dep*)]
Obtain $\tan\theta=1/(4-\sqrt3)$, or equivalent: $(4+\sqrt3)/13$, 0.4409… (2 s.f. or better). [A1]
Obtain final answer $\theta=23.8^\circ$ and no others in range. At least 3 s.f. (23.7939…); ignore extra values outside range. [A1] Total 4.
